summaries.1: 1 Ionah sent to Nineueh, fleeth to Tarshish. 4 He is bewrayed by a tempest, 11 throwen into the sea, 17 and swallowed by a fish.
summaries.2: 1 The prayer of Ionah. 10 Hee is deliuered from the fish.
summaries.3: 1 Ionah sent againe, preacheth to the Nineuites. 5 Vpon their repentance, 10 God repenteth.
summaries.4: 1 Ionah repining at Gods mercy, 4 is reprooued by the type of a Gourd.
